# Vi-Play

> Modern edge-powered media streaming platform for Movies, TV Shows, and Anime with real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream discovery and Cinema Dark UI.

Vi-Play is an open-source, experimental web interface deployed globally on Cloudflare Pages and backed by a self-contained Cloudflare Worker executing the `@vyla-entertainment/sdk`. It enables progressive stream discovery across 48+ external video scrapers without requiring a standalone VPS or Node.js server.

## Web Application Routes

- [Home](https://vi-play.pages.dev/): Discover trending movies, popular television shows, and top Japanese anime with an interactive hero carousel and curated shelves.
- [Movies](https://vi-play.pages.dev/movies): Filter and explore high-definition movies by genre, popularity, and release date.
- [TV Shows](https://vi-play.pages.dev/tv): Browse television series with full multi-season and episode listings.
- [Anime](https://vi-play.pages.dev/anime): Stream Japanese animation series and feature films with original audio, English dubs, and multi-language subtitle tracks.
- [Watchlist](https://vi-play.pages.dev/watchlist): Access bookmarked media titles saved in client-side local storage.

## Core Features & Architecture

- **Adaptive Bitrate Playback**: Powered by HLS.js with automatic resolution scaling (360p up to 4K) and direct MP4 fallback.
- **Server-Sent Events (SSE)**: Streams progressive source discovery links over `/movie` and `/tv` endpoints, minimizing time-to-first-frame.
- **Smart Stream Failover**: Automatic switching to secondary verified sources if an active stream server encounters errors or drops.
- **Subtitles Engine**: Embedded multi-language subtitle track selection with VTT and SRT rendering.
- **Private Edge Service Binding**: Cloudflare Worker backend is secured with `workers_dev = false` and routed exclusively via internal Cloudflare Pages Service Bindings (`VYLA_WORKER`).
